trans-unit.resname: Tooltips['Controls how much time it takes for RSX to start processing after waking up by the Cell processor. Increasing wakeup delay improves stability, but very high values can lower RSX/GPU performance. It is recommended to adjust this at 20µs to 40µs increments until the best value for optimal stability is reached.']
trans-unit.source: Controls how much time it takes for RSX to start processing after waking up by the Cell processor. Increasing wakeup delay improves stability, but very high values can lower RSX/GPU performance. It is recommended to adjust this at 20µs to 40µs increments until the best value for optimal stability is reached.
trans-unit.target: Styr hur lång tid det tar innan RSX börjar bearbeta efter att ha väckts av Cell-processorn. Ökad väckningsfördröjning förbättrar stabiliteten, men mycket höga värden kan sänka RSX/GPU-prestandan. Vi rekommenderar att du justerar i steg om 20 till 40 µs tills bästa värde för optimal stabilitet har nåtts.

trans-unit.resname: Tooltips['Controls how much time it takes for a PPU thread to resume after an SPU sends it an event. Increasing wakeup delay may improve stability, but very high values can lower performance. It is recommended to adjust this at 20µs to 40µs increments until the best value for optimal stability is reached.']
trans-unit.source: Controls how much time it takes for a PPU thread to resume after an SPU sends it an event. Increasing wakeup delay may improve stability, but very high values can lower performance. It is recommended to adjust this at 20µs to 40µs increments until the best value for optimal stability is reached.
trans-unit.target: Styr hur lång tid det tar innan en PPU-tråd återupptas efter att en SPU har skickat en händelse. Ökad väckningsfördröjning kan förbättra stabiliteten, men mycket höga värden kan sänka prestandan. Vi rekommenderar att du justerar i steg om 20 till 40 µs tills bästa värde för optimal stabilitet har nåtts.

trans-unit.resname: Tooltips['Compensate for hardware MMIO SPU performance not having thread delays by slowing down PPU instead. Enable only if advised.']
trans-unit.source: Compensate for hardware MMIO SPU performance not having thread delays by slowing down PPU instead. Enable only if advised.
trans-unit.target: Kompensera för att maskinvarans MMIO SPU-prestanda saknar trådfördröjningar genom att i stället sakta ned PPU. Aktivera endast om det rekommenderas.
